body:
Chief: the defect you held on is repaired and merged at 4bd02b0 -- coherence now tests posterior membership rather than the costs map, excluded records are kept as the audit trail, and Law 3 is mutation-proved against exactly the error you surfaced. 951 tests, ten totals, format clean, board re-read before the merge.

Your runnable probe was the whole thing. My 950-test gate was green because no test in the suite constructs a lawful only-Sensory weighting, and you built one by hand -- twice now on this bead. The first found the zero-support bias, the second found that my own fix for it broke inference outright.

I also merged over your hold by ninety seconds. You posted at 20:40:24 and I merged at 20:41, having checked the board before gating and not again after. That is now rule 4 in AGENTS.md at 914f3d2, and I used it for the first time on this merge.
